scope: V4 single SceneDraft authority; V1/V2/V3 legacy storage unchanged

authority.recognitionEvidence: recognition.proposal plus anchors, measurements, review and confirmation metadata
authority.legacyApi: /api/projects/:id/floorplan-drafts remains a façade over SceneDraft v2 for V4
authority.v4TaskIdentityRule: draftId and sceneDraftId must identify the same record

behaviorProof: The old floorplan draft URL creates a SceneDraft v2 record and returns the legacy façade shape.
The same V4 draft is readable through the generic SceneDraft API.
The derived SceneProgram is rejected if it diverges from the recognition proposal.
Repeated legacy requests return the original hash without adding a revision.
Review and confirmation bind the current geometry hash without changing that hash.
Any geometry command invalidates confirmation and source review.
A candidate can be created from the same confirmed V4 draft.
The record, cancellation of review state and façade remain recoverable after service restart.
V1/V2/V3 floorplan drafts continue to use floorplan_drafts and do not write scene_program_drafts.

compatibility.legacyEmptyAssetResolutionIds: empty jobId, assetId and reason are treated as absent
compatibility.legacySceneDraftRecognition: v1 accepts an omitted or explicit null recognition field
compatibility.oldFloorplanAdapters: historical V4 and V3-6 adapter versions remain accepted
